title: cracca rugelii
intro: Cracca rugelii, commonly known as the American licorice, is a perennial legume native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cracca rugelii are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Cracca rugelii include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
